theorem_title: Rational parameter selection for exponents above two
natural_language_statement: For every real ν > 2, there exist rational numbers θ, A, B, and C such that, when viewed as real numbers, 0 < θ < A < B < 1, ν(A − θ) > 1 − θ, 1 < C, B < 1/C, B < Cθ, and Cθ < 1.
